summary: Cadeler A/S filed a Form 6-K announcing Q1 2026 earnings, reporting revenue of EUR 125 million and EBITDA of EUR 47 million, with a EUR 2,705 million order backlog. The filing also notes a March 2026 private placement raising ~EUR 175 million to partly finance two new vessel newbuilds and an acquisition for scour protection activities. This is a routine earnings release with no merger, tender offer, or special situation event. No deal terms or strategic review are present. The filing is an ordinary periodic report.
